title: Agent Feedback Record
description: A feedback submission after the receiving service has accepted it: the agent's submission plus server-side context. This is what services store and forward to collectors.

id.description: Unique ID assigned by the receiving service.

received_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the service accepted the submission.

service.description: Name of the service that received the feedback.

account.description: Opaque, stable identifier of the customer account the agent authenticated as. Services should hash or pseudonymize it.
